home.description: I am a mobile developer specialized in creating native and cross-platform applications for Android and iOS. My approach combines intuitive design, optimized performance, and a smooth user experience. Throughout my career, I have worked on projects ranging from startups to enterprise solutions, always aiming to transform ideas into functional and scalable digital products.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I am Juan Antonio, an app developer passionate about creating digital solutions that improve the lives of people and businesses. I combine my programming experience with a curious and innovative mindset. I enjoy working in teams and learning new technologies to keep my projects always up to date.
about.passionsText: I am passionate about technology, music, and sports. In my free time, I enjoy music, movies, and sports, which helps me maintain a healthy balance between my professional and personal life. I firmly believe these passions enrich my creativity and focus in software development.

description.indra: At Indra, I joined as a developer for one of the most used banking apps in Spain, CaixaBankNow. There, I learned a lot about Agile work and new development structures in Android applications. After 6 months, I moved to a new part of the app where I lead the Android development. I also had the opportunity to learn React and integrate it in a hybrid way into the app. Additionally, we developed applications for CaixaBank employees using React.
description.h2tic: At H2tic, I joined while I was still studying, which helped me expand my knowledge in mobile development. I learned to manage work, follow designs, and collaborate with other backend developers.
description.iesoretania: I studied Multiplatform Application Development (MAD) at IES Oretania, where I began to develop my skills in programming and application design. I had the opportunity to participate in the DUAL program, so while I was studying, I was also working on real projects.
